Render a basemap for bounds in one call

Source: R/render_basemap_raw.R
render_basemap_raw.Rd

A one-shot render: fit bounds into a width x height CSS-pixel view and return the pixels. basemap() with render_array() gives the same result with a reusable view; plot integrations use this function. The same function exists in Python (basemapper.render_basemap_raw()).

Usage

render_basemap_raw(
  bounds,
  width,
  height,
  style,
  crs = NULL,
  pixel_ratio = 1,
  tile_zoom = NULL,
  layers = NULL,
  labels = TRUE,
  features = NULL,
  auth_token = NULL,
  tile_timeout_ms = 10000L,
  max_tiles = 256L,
  tile_concurrency = 16L,
  fail_on_tile_error = FALSE
)

Arguments

bounds

Bounding box: c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in crs (default EPSG:4326, with a message when the values look projected), an sf::st_bbox() result, or an sf / sfc / sfg object (CRS read from the object).

width, height

View size in CSS pixels.

style

A MapLibre GL style URL or JSON string (e.g. from basemap_provider()), or a character vector / list of those stacked bottom to top (e.g. a basemap published as separate hillshade, base and label services).

crs

CRS of bounds (anything sf::st_crs() accepts).

pixel_ratio

Device pixels per CSS pixel.

tile_zoom

Tile detail override: the tile zoom on the 256 px grid (vector sources use one less, their tiles being 512 px), or NULL to pick tiles as MapLibre does for the view.

layers

Optional layer filter applied to every style: plain IDs keep only those layers, minus-prefixed IDs drop them; * and ? are wildcards ("-label_*"). See list_layers(). Names that match no layer of any style warn.

labels

TRUE keeps every layer, FALSE drops the labels (text and icons), "only" keeps only the labels on a transparent background, to stack over another map. Catalogue raster basemaps switch to their label-free or label-only tiles.

features

Optional feature filter applied to every style: plain names keep those features, minus-prefixed names drop them, e.g. c("water", "roads") or "-buildings". Features: background, water, landcover, parks, buildings, roads, rail, boundaries, places, poi, terrain, other (the feature column of list_layers()). Features no layer of any style belongs to warn.

auth_token

Optional access token for the tile service.

tile_timeout_ms

Per-tile HTTP timeout in milliseconds.

max_tiles

Maximum tiles fetched per style.

tile_concurrency

Parallel tile downloads.

fail_on_tile_error

Abort on a failed tile instead of leaving it empty.

Value

An integer array [height * pixel_ratio, width * pixel_ratio, 4] (RGBA, 0–255) with the input extent as attributes xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax and crs_epsg (NA for a non-EPSG CRS).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# WGS-84 bounds (default CRS)
a <- render_basemap_raw(c(-122.5, 37.7, -122.4, 37.8), 400, 300,
                        "OpenFreeMap.Positron")

# sf object: CRS read from it; two styles stacked; 2x pixels
nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)
a <- render_basemap_raw(nc, 400, 300,
                        c("Esri.WorldShadedRelief",
                          "OpenFreeMap.Positron"),
                        pixel_ratio = 2)
} # }
